summary.label: Spatial summary of modeled annual surface maxima; not a time mean.

raster.sampling: Nearest source-triangle centroid within450m, searched in a local7×7 mesh-cell neighborhood. No fabricated interpolation values.

temporal.label: Historical Diviner PRP annual surface maximum from first mapping-year thermal-model fits
temporal.note: The PDS4 product marks start and stop dates inapplicable; no calendar2025 observation is implied.

quality.sourceQualityFlag: No per-facet temperature quality flag is supplied in this PRP table.

source.title: LRO Diviner South Polar Resource Product V2: annual maximum surface temperature
source.method: Fixed-width source field188..195 is read as kelvin; temp_avg at 2 cm is not used. PRP model fits: Paige et al. (2010), doi:10.1126/science.1187726; Kaguya-based triangular mesh.
source.caveat: Modeled annual extreme, not instantaneous thermal imagery. Source mesh and its modeling assumptions differ from the LOLA terrain DEM.

comparability.reason: Context only: Diviner annual modeled surface maxima, MEDA sampled-sol brightness observations and Earth 2025 daily-mean skin-temperature reanalysis use different statistics, spatial supports and periods. No cross-product thermal similarity score is calculated.
